name: TaskFlow
description: A task management web application with REST API backend
conventions: All endpoints return JSON with consistent error format: {detail, code}
Use dependency injection for database sessions
Business logic lives in services, not routes
One migration file per schema change, never modify existing migrations
All list endpoints must be paginated with limit/offset
infra_constraints: No new databases without team approval
No managed cloud services — self-hosted only
All background jobs must be idempotent
existing_data_models: tasks (id, title, description, status, priority, assigned_to, created_at)
nfrs: All endpoints must require authentication except /health and /auth/login
Response time < 200ms for API calls under normal load
forbidden: No WebSockets — use REST polling only
No new ORMs or query builders
